Password reset token is md5(username) — deterministic, guessable by anyone who knows the username — enabling full account takeover via /api/reset-password
/api/forgot-password returns the reset token in the HTTP response as 'debug_token'
/api/reset-password validates token only against md5(username), so the token is trivially computable and any attacker can reset any account

/api/split-bill lets the caller specify from_user_id, debiting any account and crediting any account (unauthorized fund drain)

Hardcoded production-style credentials: API key, AWS access/secret, Stripe key, database password, SendGrid key, GitHub token, JWT key, Slack webhook
